purpose: A new traceable target dataset for reviewer-directed revision, not certified reconstruction of the missing original export
sample_selection_reason: Fixed calendar coverage of dry/monsoon/post-monsoon, leap/non-leap February, early record and later development; no score or agreement-based month selection

country_geometry.boundary_policy: Natural Earth default de facto country geometry; no POV adjustment
country_geometry.limitation: Cartographic border; not cadastral truth, historical yearly boundary or the original CHIRPS mask

spatial_rule.country_inclusion: Pixel center covered by country polygon, including polygon boundary and all source components inside the client box
spatial_rule.bbox_inclusion: lat_min <= center_lat < lat_max and lon_min <= center_lon < lon_max
spatial_rule.area_weight: Absolute WGS84 geodesic quadrilateral area from four original pixel corners using pyproj.Geod.polygon_area_perimeter
spatial_rule.cell_weight_scope: Full selected cell, not fractional country intersection
spatial_rule.overlaps: Retained and measured for every client pair; no exclusive partition or spatial independence claim
spatial_rule.national_domain: Five selected study domains; not complete national coverage

nodata_semantics_source: Official CHIRPS2 FAQ, including COGs without an embedded GDAL nodata tag
coverage_definition: Valid selected pixel area / all geometrically selected pixel area
no_valid_support: Fail; never impute or substitute zero
other_negative_or_nonfinite_values: Fail; no silent clipping or removal
mean_definition: Sum(valid rainfall_mm * geodesic cell area) / sum(valid geodesic cell area)
temporal_aggregation: Use the native monthly total directly; no multiplication by days or summation of monthly means

availability.monthly_label_assumed_release: day 21 of the following month at 00:00 UTC
availability.issue: first day of target month at 00:00 UTC
availability.interpretation: Retrospective final-product data with declared latency assumption; not an operational historical-vintage forecast
